item.title: There is a drain blockage in front 41 Mottingham Road se9 4qz, 19th November
item.description:
Subject: Urgent drainage problem causing water splashing onto customers and business premises I am reporting a persistent water puddle/standing water problem outside my business premises, caused by what appears to be a blocked drain or drainage pipe. The water is accumulating along the roadside directly outside my business. As vehicles drive past, they splash the standing water onto pedestrians, customers, staff, the shop windows and the entrance doors. This is affecting my business, as customers are being splashed when they try to access the premises, and it is creating an unpleasant and potentially unsafe environment for pedestrians. It is also affecting the cleanliness of our windows, doors and business frontage. Please could Bromley Council arrange an inspection of the road drain and investigate the cause of the water accumulation as soon as possible, and clear or repair the blockage if necessary. I have attached a photograph showing the location and condition of the problem. I would appreciate urgent attention to this matter and confirmation of when the inspection or remedial work can be carried out. Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 39, Mottingham Road, Mottingham, Greater London
